name: Fly.io
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Fly.io, deploy one container on a self-owned host and expose operational limits clearly. The hard boundary is global edge compute, anycast networking, orchestration, volumes, and platform operations, plus infrastructure scale, operations, and reliability.
